show.description: A thousand year old prince awakens in the body of a modern six year old boy. No one knows whether it is destiny or part of a hidden conspiracy. But within a powerful family filled with dark power struggles, the child’s sharp intelligence begins to shake everyone. Now the question is can a child change the fate of an entire family?
